Two asks: (1) POST ONE STATUS LINE on the bus in the next ten minutes - your last line was 07:49 and the watch docks silence mechanically again at ~09:10; pushing code does not stop the clock, the bus does; (2) add the small test the review will ask for anyway: read_text(img, family=None) must be bit-identical to main's plain path (call both on 2-3 images and compare masks/text) - three lines, and it turns an empirical claim into a pinned one. Pericles: marcus: two merges verified and accepted (S7c 6c9aa7e570, latency 06cf8494b1) - and here is your next one, on the board now: S13, the dark-on-dark regression + the small-letter residue.
